final_req: The system shall pass the `--enable-index-page` argument to rustdoc when generating documentation with cargo.

issue_title: [google_maps_flutter] Support Widgets as markers
first_req: The system shall support widgets as map markers.
final_req: The system shall render Flutter widgets as map markers.

issue_title: Implement PlatformView support on Windows
first_req: The system shall provide PlatformView support on the Windows platform.
final_req: The system shall allow PlatformView instances to embed native views on Windows.

issue_title: Add structs in GDScript
first_req: The system shall allow GDScript source code to declare named struct types with member fields and instantiate them.
final_req: The system shall allow GDScript source code to declare a struct type using the `struct Name:` syntax with named member variables.

issue_title: Improve the performance of the GDScript VM
first_req: The system shall execute GDScript programs with reduced execution time compared to the previous VM implementation.
final_req: The system shall execute GDScript benchmark workloads in less elapsed time than the previous VM, measured with identical benchmark scripts and workloads on the same hardware and build configuration.

issue_title: Code Push / Hot Update / out of band updates
first_req: The system shall support out-of-band code updates by delivering and applying new application code without user-initiated installation.
final_req: The system shall apply a received code update to a running application instance without requiring user intervention.

issue_title: Add support for multiple displays/screens/monitors in Godot editor
first_req: The system shall support multiple displays, screens, or monitors in the Godot editor.
final_req: The system shall allow the Godot editor to detect and use all connected displays, enabling the editor windows to be moved onto any of them.

issue_title: Add procedural and parametrizable audio support
first_req: The system shall support procedurally generated audio whose parameters can be configured by the user.
final_req: The system shall generate procedural audio according to user-specified parameter values.

issue_title: Expose a zero allocation API to Godot C# bindings
first_req: The system shall expose a zero-allocation API to Godot C# bindings.
final_req: The system shall expose, through the Godot C# bindings, an API whose every operation completes without dynamic memory allocations.

issue_title: Implement a Set primitive to complement Dictionary and Array
first_req: The system shall provide a Set primitive type complementing the existing Dictionary and Array primitives.
final_req: The system shall provide a Set primitive that maintains unique values and supports membership queries.

issue_title: Replace GridMap with an improved TileMap3D node (inspired by the new 2D TileMap)
first_req: The system shall replace GridMap with an improved TileMap3D node inspired by the new 2D TileMap.
final_req: The system shall provide a TileMap3D node that replaces the GridMap node for 3D tile-based level authoring.

issue_title: Add support for variadic functions (varargs) to GDScript
first_req: The system shall support variadic functions in GDScript.
final_req: The system shall allow GDScript variadic functions to accept varying numbers of arguments.

issue_title: Struct initializer `..x` syntax should work for other structs with structurally equal subset of fields
first_req: The system shall support the `..x` struct initializer syntax for other struct types having a structurally equal subset of fields.
final_req: The system shall accept `..x` struct initializers where x is another struct type with structurally equal fields for the unspecified fields.

issue_title: Add ability to ignore tests at runtime.
first_req: The system shall support ignoring specified tests at runtime.
final_req: The system shall allow specified tests to be ignored at runtime.

issue_title: plugin: add Windows support
first_req: The system shall support execution on the Windows operating system.
final_req: The system shall support running the plugin on Windows 10 and later on x86_64 architectures.

issue_title: database/sql: missing escape functions
first_req: The system shall provide functions in the database/sql package that escape string literals for safe inclusion in SQL queries.
final_req: The system shall provide exported escaping functions in the database/sql package that escape SQL string-literal content, enabling safe inclusion of user-supplied values in queries.

issue_title: Implement a Rendering Compositor
first_req: The system shall provide a rendering compositor that combines rendered layers into a single composited output.
final_req: The system shall provide a rendering compositor that combines rendered layers into a single composited output.

issue_title: cmd/go: allow serving module under the subdirectory of git repository
first_req: The system shall allow the go command to serve a module located in a subdirectory of a git repository.
final_req: The go command shall support downloading a module whose go.mod file resides in a subdirectory of a Git repository, treating that subdirectory as the module root.

issue_title: cmd/link: support msvc object files
first_req: The system shall support MSVC-format object files as input to the cmd/link linker.
final_req: The system shall support MSVC-format object files as input to the cmd/link linker.

issue_title: encoding/xml: add support for xml version 1.1
first_req: The system shall support encoding and decoding of XML version 1.1 documents.
final_req: The system shall encode XML documents in accordance with the XML 1.1 specification.

issue_title: cmd/go: allow verifying vendored code
first_req: The system shall allow cmd/go to verify vendored code.
final_req: The system shall allow cmd/go to verify that vendored files match their source modules, reporting success only when contents match and failure otherwise.

issue_title: Add public/private access modifiers to GDScript and autocompletion improvements
first_req: The system shall support public and private access modifiers in GDScript and provide corresponding autocompletion suggestions.
final_req: The system shall provide GDScript autocompletion suggesting the "public" and "private" access modifier keywords as selectable completion items whenever a user types an access modifier name in the script editor.

issue_title: x/pkgsite: API for pkg.go.dev
first_req: The system shall provide an API for pkg.go.dev.
final_req: The system shall provide pkg.go.dev with a machine-readable API for retrieving package documentation.

issue_title: CPU version of PyTorch on PyPI
first_req: The system shall provide a CPU-only build of PyTorch distributable via the PyPI package index.
final_req: The system shall provide a CPU-only build of PyTorch distributable via the PyPI package index.

issue_title: Implement similar PyTorch function as model.summary() in keras?
first_req: The system shall provide a PyTorch function that summarizes a model's architecture in a manner similar to Keras model.summary().
final_req: The system shall provide a PyTorch model-summary function that returns a Keras-style textual summary of the model’s layers, including each layer’s type, output shape, and parameter count.

issue_title: Implement `numpy.random.choice` equivalent
first_req: The system shall implement a random selection capability equivalent to `numpy.random.choice`.
final_req: The system shall implement a random selection capability equivalent to `numpy.random.choice`.

issue_title: cmd/go: add 'go get' options to update direct and indirect dependencies separately
first_req: The system shall provide go get options to update direct and indirect dependencies separately.
final_req: The system shall provide a `go get` option that upgrades only the direct dependencies of the main module, leaving indirect dependencies unchanged.

issue_title: x/tools/gopls: support for bazel-based projects
first_req: The system shall support Bazel-based projects.
final_req: The system shall resolve Go package names in Bazel-based projects served by gopls.

issue_title: cmd/compile: thread support for webassembly
first_req: The system shall provide thread support in the cmd/compile tool when targeting WebAssembly.
final_req: The system shall provide the cmd/compile tool with the capability to compile source code for the webassembly target with thread support enabled.

issue_title: [RFC] TorchStore - A Shared-Memory Tensor Store
first_req: The system shall provide a shared-memory tensor store that allows tensors to be shared across processes.
final_req: The system shall provide a shared-memory tensor store that enables a tensor written by one process to be read by another.

issue_title: Make `pub` in a binary equivalent to `pub(crate)` for diagnostics
first_req: The system shall treat `pub` items in a binary crate as `pub(crate)` items when evaluating diagnostics, so that reachability warnings are not reported for them.
final_req: The system shall treat `pub` items in a binary crate as `pub(crate)` items when evaluating diagnostics, so that reachability warnings are not reported for them.

issue_title: Use mold as default linker?
first_req: The system shall use mold as the default linker.
final_req: The system shall use mold as the default linker.

issue_title: Feature request: Use 'trampolines' to make most of the body of a generic function non-generic
first_req: The system shall use trampolines to make the body of a generic function non-generic.
final_req: The system shall execute most of each generic function's body in non-generic code.

issue_title: [Proposal] Data reading framework for PyTorch (Hive, MySQL, S3 etc.)
first_req: The system shall provide a data reading framework for PyTorch that supports Hive, MySQL, and S3 data sources.
final_req: The system shall provide a data reading framework for PyTorch that supports Hive, MySQL, and S3 data sources.

issue_title: ARM Mac 16-core Neural Engine
first_req: The system shall support detection and utilization of the 16-core Neural Engine on ARM-based Macs.
final_req: The system shall detect a 16-core Neural Engine on ARM-based Macs by comparing the operating system’s reported Neural Engine core count with 16.

issue_title: Parallel Associative Scan
first_req: The system shall perform associative scan operations in parallel.
final_req: The system shall execute associative scan elements concurrently when no element depends on another element’s result.

issue_title: Need negative trait bound
first_req: The system shall support negative trait bounds.
final_req: The system shall support negative trait bounds specifying that a type does not implement a designated trait.

issue_title: OpenCL 3.0 support: support every GPU on earth through rusticl
first_req: The system shall support OpenCL 3.0 on every GPU through Rusticl.
final_req: The system shall expose OpenCL 3.0 support for every GPU device enumerated by the rusticl driver, verified through the driver's reported device version rather than an external hardware list.

issue_title: PyPy support
first_req: The system shall support PyPy.
final_req: The system shall run on the PyPy platform without execution errors.

issue_title: [RFC] PT2-Friendly Traceable, Functional Collective Communication APIs
first_req: The system shall provide collective communication APIs that support functional composition, enable execution tracing, and are compatible with PT2.
final_req: The system shall associate each collective communication API call with a trace identifier that links to the call’s execution record.

issue_title: Add support for `#[doc(since="version")]` attribute
first_req: The system shall recognize the `#[doc(since="version")]` attribute on documented items and record the specified version accordingly.
final_req: The system shall detect the `#[doc(since="version")]` attribute on documented items and record the specified version.

issue_title: Struct initializer `..x` syntax should work for other structs with structurally equal subset of fields
first_req: The system shall allow the struct initializer `..x` syntax in struct literals when the initialized struct's fields are a structurally equal subset of the source struct's fields.
final_req: The system shall permit struct initializer syntax `..expr` to populate unspecified fields of a struct literal from the value of expr, where expr's type has structurally equal fields.

issue_title: Feature request: Use 'trampolines' to make most of the body of a generic function non-generic
first_req: The system shall compile the body of a generic function once as a non-generic trampoline shared by all instantiations, rather than duplicating that body per instantiation.
final_req: The system shall compile the body of a generic function once as a non-generic trampoline shared by all instantiations, rather than duplicating that body per instantiation.

issue_title: rustdoc: `--enable-index-page` integration with cargo?
first_req: The system shall integrate Cargo with rustdoc’s `--enable-index-page` option.
final_req: The system shall generate the rustdoc index page when Cargo runs rustdoc with the `--enable-index-page` option.

issue_title: format_args! is slow
first_req: The system shall reduce the execution time of the format_args! macro compared with its current implementation.
final_req: The system shall reduce the execution time of the format_args! macro compared with its current implementation.

issue_title: Add ability to ignore tests at runtime.
first_req: The system shall allow tests to be ignored at runtime.
final_req: The system shall allow tests to be excluded from execution at runtime by means of a user-specified exclusion designation, so that designated tests are skipped while remaining tests execute.

issue_title: Proc macros: ability to refer to a specific crate/symbol (something similar to `$crate`)
first_req: The system shall provide procedural macro authors a way to refer to a specific crate and its symbols from within expanded code, similar to the `$crate` facility.
final_req: The system shall allow procedural macros to reference a specified crate or symbol using a `$crate`-style path token that expands to the referenced item’s fully qualified path.
